title: 信息日报 2026-10-02

headline.title: 中方代表28国呼吁国际社会遏止单边强制措施
headline.summary: 中国常驻联合国代表傅聪在联大第三委员会代表28个观点相近国家就单边强制措施作共同发言，呼吁国际社会坚决遏止这一非法行径。
headline.title_en: Chinese Representative, on Behalf of 28 Countries, Calls on International Community to Stop Unilateral Coercive Measures
headline.summary_en: China's Permanent Representative to the UN Fu Cong, on behalf of 28 like-minded countries, delivered a joint statement at the Third Committee of the UN General Assembly on unilateral coercive measures, calling on the international community to firmly stop such illegal acts.
headline.original_title: 中方代表28国呼吁国际社会遏止单边强制措施
headline.reason: 这是当天得分最高的候选新闻，涉及28国在联合国共同发声，反映国际社会对单边强制措施的共同关切，具有重要国际影响。
headline.reason_en: This is the highest-scored candidate of the day, involving 28 countries jointly speaking at the UN, reflecting international concerns over unilateral coercive measures and carrying significant global impact.
